9: 
10:     HAS_ARFF = True
11: except:
12:     HAS_ARFF = False

14: from sklearn.utils.estimator_checks import _NotAnArray as NotAnArray
15: from sklearn.utils.validation import check_array as sk_check_array
16: from sklearn.utils.validation import check_X_y as sk_check_X_y

24: def fix_force_all_finite_warning(func):
25:     """ Make sure to use sklearn >=1.6 ensure_finite_attribute if available
26:         rather than deprecated force_all_attribute """
27:     def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
28:         if ('force_all_finite' in kwargs and
29:                 inspect.signature(sk_check_array).parameters.get('ensure_all_finite')):
30:             kwargs['ensure_all_finite'] = kwargs.pop('force_all_finite')
31:         return func(*args, **kwargs)
32:     return wrapper
33: 
34: 
35: check_array = fix_force_all_finite_warning(sk_check_array)
36: check_X_y = fix_force_all_finite_warning(sk_check_X_y)
37: 
38: 
39: def check_variable_length_input(X):
40:     """Input validation on a variable length dataset.
41: 
42:     Parameters
43:     ----------
44:     X : object
45:         Input object to check / convert.
46: 
47:     Returns
48:     -------
49:         array_converted : object
50:         The converted and validated array.
51:     """
52:     if getattr(X, "shape", None) is None:
53:         if isinstance(X, NotAnArray):
54:             X = check_array(X, allow_nd=True, force_all_finite=False)
55:         else:
56:             # Check each time series when X can be of variable length before
57:             # to_time_series_dataset processing
58:             for ts in X:
59:                 check_array([ts], allow_nd=True, force_all_finite=False)
60:     else:
61:         X = check_array(X, allow_nd=True, force_all_finite=False)
62:     return to_time_series_dataset(X)

64: 
65: def check_dims(X, X_fit_dims=None, extend=True, check_n_features_only=False):
66:     """Reshapes X to a 3-dimensional array of X.shape[0] univariate
67:     timeseries of length X.shape[1] if X is 2-dimensional and extend
68:     is True. Then checks whether the provided X_fit_dims and the
69:     dimensions of X (except for the first one), match.
70: 
71:     Parameters
72:     ----------
73:     X : array-like
74:         The first array to be compared.
75:     X_fit_dims : tuple (default: None)
76:         The dimensions of the data generated by fit, to compare with
77:         the dimensions of the provided array X.
78:         If None, then only perform reshaping of X, if necessary.
79:     extend : boolean (default: True)
80:         Whether to reshape X, if it is 2-dimensional.
81:     check_n_features_only: boolean (default: False)
82: 
83:     Returns
84:     -------
85:     array
86:         Reshaped X array
87: 
88:     Examples
89:     --------
90:     >>> X = numpy.empty((10, 3))
91:     >>> check_dims(X).shape
92:     (10, 3, 1)
93:     >>> X = numpy.empty((10, 3, 1))
94:     >>> check_dims(X).shape
95:     (10, 3, 1)
96:     >>> X_fit_dims = (5, 3, 1)
97:     >>> check_dims(X, X_fit_dims).shape
98:     (10, 3, 1)
99:     >>> X_fit_dims = (5, 3, 2)
100:     >>> check_dims(X, X_fit_dims)  # doctest: +IGNORE_EXCEPTION_DETAIL
101:     Traceback (most recent call last):
102:     ValueError: Dimensions (except first) must match! ((5, 3, 2) and (10, 3, 1)
103:     are passed shapes)
104:     >>> X_fit_dims = (5, 5, 1)
105:     >>> check_dims(X, X_fit_dims, check_n_features_only=True).shape
106:     (10, 3, 1)
107:     >>> X_fit_dims = (5, 5, 2)
108:     >>> check_dims(
109:     ...     X,
110:     ...     X_fit_dims,
111:     ...     check_n_features_only=True
112:     ... )  # doctest: +IGNORE_EXCEPTION_DETAIL
113:     Traceback (most recent call last):
114:     ValueError: Number of features of the provided timeseries must match!
115:     (last dimension) must match the one of the fitted data!
116:     ((5, 5, 2) and (10, 3, 1) are passed shapes)
117: 
118:     Raises
119:     ------
120:     ValueError
121:         Will raise exception if X is None or (if X_fit_dims is provided) one
122:         of the dimensions of the provided data, except the first, does not
123:         match X_fit_dims.
124:     """
125:     if X is None:
126:         raise ValueError("X is equal to None!")
127: 
128:     if extend and len(X.shape) == 2:
129:         warnings.warn(
130:             "2-Dimensional data passed. Assuming these are "
131:             "{} 1-dimensional timeseries".format(X.shape[0])
132:         )
133:         X = X.reshape((X.shape) + (1,))
134: 
135:     if X_fit_dims is not None:
136:         if check_n_features_only:
137:             if X_fit_dims[2] != X.shape[2]:
138:                 raise ValueError(
139:                     "Number of features of the provided timeseries"
140:                     "(last dimension) must match the one of the fitted data!"
141:                     " ({} and {} are passed shapes)".format(X_fit_dims, X.shape)
142:                 )
143:         else:
144:             if X_fit_dims[1:] != X.shape[1:]:
145:                 raise ValueError(
146:                     "Dimensions of the provided timeseries"
147:                     "(except first) must match those of the fitted data!"
148:                     " ({} and {} are passed shapes)".format(X_fit_dims, X.shape)
149:                 )
150: 
151:     return X
152:

154: def to_time_series(ts, remove_nans=False, be=None, dtype=float):
155:     """Transforms a time series so that it fits the format used in ``tslearn``
156:     models.
157: 
158:     Parameters
159:     ----------
160:     ts : array-like, shape=(sz, d) or (sz,)
161:         The time series to be transformed.
162:         If shape is (sz,), the time series is assumed to be univariate.
163:     remove_nans : bool (default: False)
164:         Whether trailing NaNs at the end of the time series should be removed
